description: The blog list once preview links exist: a third group above Drafts and Published holding two unlisted clones. One is an ordinary preview; the other is password-protected, so it shows the placeholder title Protected preview rather than its real one — the title is encrypted at rest alongside the body, which is why the list cannot show it either. The @codeyam/cms 0.5.0 upgrade is what added this group.
